title: The visual abstract
caption: The one-page case for counting the level on the C-arm the hospital already owns: the never event, operating-room time, what a wrong level costs, navigation's price, and a per-hospital model with every input labelled.

source.notes: The whole artifact page, rendered in headless Chromium and captured as one image; its numbers carry its own reference list. Its icons are decoration and are not kept apart.
